settings.printer_settings_id: Bambu Lab H2C 0.8 Standard +0.04 Z trim

passage_reading_method: Minimum point-to-extrusion-centerline distance minus half the annotated width, including all extrusion roles. These are nominal toolpath footprints, not measured deposited plastic.
forming_speed_sample_method: Outer-wall segment midpoints in selected layers, inside the CAD surface modifier with a 0.15 mm boundary margin; section plane is 0.08 mm below nominal layer Z.
